buckets.description: Review advice, links, examples and wording.
buckets.label: Documentation checks

buckets.label: Source/citation checks

buckets.description: Review the required technical source and retained execution or UI evidence. This queue grants no permission to run a test.
buckets.label: Technical verification

buckets.description: Resolve the specific missing permission, input or environment.
buckets.label: Prerequisite unavailable

buckets.description: Correct the recorded defect or missing citation, then recheck.
buckets.label: Correction needed

buckets.description: The review type, status or required check is unrecognized. Inspect the record before assigning work.
buckets.label: Needs triage

buckets.description: Checked within the recorded scope, or explicitly not applicable. This is not human acceptance.
buckets.label: Completed checks

queue.countMeaning: Counts are passages, not unique questions. Shared wording does not mean the same proven fact. Each passage keeps its own evidence and review status.
